categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在模型压缩与蒸馏、LLM 能力边界评测，以及 AI 的社会语义影响与失控风险刻画。

articles.title: Automatic keyphrase extraction and annotation: modern theoretical approaches and practical solutions for text and speech
articles.zh: 自动关键词抽取与标注：面向文本与语音的现代理论方法与实用方案
articles.summary: 如果你在做内容打标签、检索或语音转写后的结构化整理，这篇把关键词抽取的理论路线和可用方案一次性梳理清楚了
articles.author: Daria Guseva, Olga Mitrofanova
articles.body: The exponential growth of textual and audiovisual information has made the task of automatic keyphrase extraction (KE) increasingly significant. This article provides a comprehensive analysis of contemporary theoretical approaches and practical solutions for KE across both text and speech modalities. The primary contribution of this work is its systematic synthesis of these often-disparate research strands into a unified analytical framework, highlighting the evolution of the field from statistical methods towards large language models (LLMs) and end-to-end speech processing. We examine the stages of KE, the characteristics of keyphrases in written and spoken language, and terminological nuances. Various methods for automatic KE are discussed and analyzed in detail: statistical, hybrid, machine learning-based, and structural. The review dedicates substantial attention to emerging paradigms, including keyphrase generation using LLMs, and provides a detailed overview of methodologies and challenges in automatic corpus annotation. Furthermore, we specifically analyze current directions and inherent difficulties in KE for spoken language, comparing transcript based and end-to-end acoustic approaches. This synthesis leads us to conclude that the field is moving towards a more integrated, context-aware paradigm. Future progress will depend on addressing key challenges such as data scarcity for low-resource languages, effective multimodal fusion, and the nuanced evaluation of generative KE systems.
articles.bodyZh: 文字和音视频信息爆炸式增长，让自动关键词提取（automatic keyphrase extraction，KE）这件事变得越来越重要。这篇文章全面梳理了文本和语音两种模态下，关键词提取目前的理论路线和实际做法。它最主要的贡献，是把这些常常比较分散的研究方向系统地整合进一个统一的分析框架，并点明这个领域是怎么从统计方法，一步步走向大语言模型（large language models，LLMs）和端到端语音处理（end-to-end speech processing）的。我们看了关键词提取的各个阶段、书面语和口语里的关键词各有什么特点，以及术语上的细微差别。文章还详细讨论和分析了各种自动关键词提取方法：统计法、混合法、基于机器学习的方法，还有结构化方法。这篇综述花了很多笔墨关注新兴范式，包括用大语言模型做关键词生成（keyphrase generation），也详细概述了自动语料标注（automatic corpus annotation）的方法和难点。另外，我们专门分析了口语关键词提取当前的方向和固有难点，比较了基于转写文本（transcript-based）和端到端声学（end-to-end acoustic）这两类做法。综合这些分析，我们得出的结论是：这个领域正在走向一个更整合、更会利用上下文（context-aware）的范式。未来能不能取得进展，要看能不能解决几个关键挑战：低资源语言（low-resource languages）的数据稀缺、有效的多模态融合（multimodal fusion），以及对生成式关键词提取（generative KE）系统做更细致、更有层次的评估。

articles.title: Compression Through a Context Lens: Evaluating Adaptation, Quantization, and Distillation in Arabic Legal LLMs
articles.zh: 从上下文视角看压缩：阿拉伯语法律 LLM 的适配、量化与蒸馏评估
articles.summary: 如果你想在小语种垂直领域压模型，这篇提醒你压缩手段的效果高度依赖领域上下文，别直接照搬英文上的结论
articles.author: Md. Rafiul Biswas, George Mikros 等
articles.body: Model compression can facilitate the deployment of large language models in resource-constrained legal settings, but its effects on domain-specific performance may depend on the evaluation protocol. We investigate this issue using ArabLegalEval, a Saudi Arabic legal benchmark, under both with-context and no-context evaluation. The former provides supporting legal passages, while the latter assesses performance without external context. Removing the context produces accuracy gaps of up to 27 percentage points for the base model. We examine three stages: domain adaptation, quantization, and knowledge distillation across FANAR-9B, JAIS-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B. Four-bit quantization reduces model memory by 64-71%, with changes in no-context MCQ accuracy ranging from -3.2 to +1.6 percentage points. Distillation produces more variable results, with accuracy generally declining as student size decreases. A Qwen2.5-7B student distilled from FANAR achieves 76.6% no-context accuracy, compared with 77.2% for its teacher. Our findings suggest that no-context evaluation provides a useful complement to context-supported testing when assessing the effects of adaptation and compression on Arabic legal language models.
articles.bodyZh: 模型压缩（Model compression）能帮大语言模型（large language models）更顺利地在资源受限的法律场景里部署（deployment），但它对领域特定性能（domain-specific performance）的影响，可能得看评测方案（evaluation protocol）怎么定。我们拿沙特阿拉伯语法律基准测试（benchmark）ArabLegalEval 来研究这个问题，分别做了有上下文（with-context）和无上下文（no-context）两种评估：前者会给辅助法律段落，后者不给外部上下文，只看模型自己表现。结果发现，对基础模型（base model）来说，把上下文拿掉后，准确率差距最高能到27个百分点。我们还看了三个阶段：领域适应（domain adaptation）、量化（quantization）和知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation），覆盖 FANAR-9B、JAIS-8B 和 Qwen2.5-7B。4比特量化（4-bit quantization）能把模型内存占用降64%到71%，而无上下文选择题（MCQ）准确率的变化在-3.2到+1.6个百分点之间。蒸馏的结果波动更大，学生模型（student）越小，准确率通常越低。用 FANAR 蒸馏出来的 Qwen2.5-7B 学生模型，无上下文准确率能到76.6%，它的教师模型（teacher）是77.2%。我们的发现说明，在评估领域适应和压缩对阿拉伯语法律模型的影响时，无上下文评测能给有上下文测试提供一个有用的补充。

articles.title: Technohybridism: Recursive Semantic Normalization in AI-Mediated Societies
articles.zh: 技术混合主义：AI 中介社会中的递归语义规范化
articles.summary: 如果你关心 AI 怎么悄悄把人类的表达方式越磨越统一，这篇给了一个"语义被递归规范化"的概念框架
articles.author: Charalampos M. Liapis, Epameinondas Panagopoulos
articles.body: Language-generating AI systems are no longer only objects of linguistic interaction: their outputs increasingly re-enter the communicative and institutional practices from which their training material was drawn. Drawing on social theory, social epistemology, and the philosophy of language, this article develops a sociotechnical account of that re-entry. We introduce recursive semantic normalization: the process through which machine-generated formulations, once recurrently taken up, evaluated, reused, and institutionally retained, participate in the reproduction and transformation of semantic regularities. Under the heading of technohybridism, we argue that the relevant unit of analysis is the hybrid semantic system, a recursively coupled configuration of human practices, computational generation, and institutional uptake. First, we distinguish the concept from neighbouring accounts, including model collapse, looping effects, machine habitus, machine culture, and the epistemology of AI testimony. Second, we develop an analytical model that separates generation, selection, uptake, and persistence and distinguishes machine-attributable change from change that would have occurred anyway. Third, we analyse uptake as routinized, institutionally diffused, and socially stratified practice and state conditions under which machine-derived regularities become norms. Fourth, we identify social-epistemic consequences: the laundering of provenance that weakens epistemic vigilance, the erosion of the cognitive diversity on which collective inquiry depends, and the narrowing of shared hermeneutical resources. An evidential ladder for empirical research follows. The account attributes no normative authority to machine outputs; what changes is the field within which human and institutional uptake operates.
articles.bodyZh: 语言生成式人工智能系统（language-generating AI systems）不再只是语言互动的对象：它们生成的内容，正越来越多地回流到当初给它们提供训练素材的交流实践和制度实践里。这篇文章借助社会理论（social theory）、社会认识论（social epistemology）和语言哲学（philosophy of language），对这种“回流”给出了一套社会技术层面的解释。我们提出“递归语义规范化”（recursive semantic normalization）这个概念：机器生成的表达一旦被反复采用、评估、复用，并被制度保留下来，就会参与语义规律的复制和改变。在“技术混合主义”（technohybridism）这个名头下，我们认为，真正该拿来分析的单位是“混合语义系统”（hybrid semantic system），也就是人的实践、计算生成和制度接收三者递归耦合起来的一套配置。第一，我们把这个概念跟相邻的解释区分开，包括模型崩溃（model collapse）、循环效应（looping effects）、机器惯习（machine habitus）、机器文化（machine culture）和AI证词认识论（epistemology of AI testimony）。第二，我们搭一个分析模型，把生成、选择、接收和持续存在分开来看，也把可归因于机器的变化，跟就算没有机器本来也会发生的变化区分开。第三，我们把接收看成一种常规化、在制度中扩散、并且在社会上分层的实践，并说明在什么条件下，机器带来的规律会变成规范。第四，我们指出社会认识论上的后果：来源洗白（laundering of provenance）会削弱认知警觉（epistemic vigilance），集体探究（collective inquiry）所依赖的认知多样性（cognitive diversity）会被侵蚀，共享解释资源（shared hermeneutical resources）也会变窄。接下来，是一套给实证研究用的证据阶梯（evidential ladder）。这套说法不给机器输出任何规范权威；真正变的是人类和机构接收、采纳这些内容时所在的那片场域。

articles.title: How Far Can Lightweight LLMs Go in Intent-to-SLO Translation?
articles.zh: 轻量级 LLM 在意图到 SLO 转换上能走多远？
articles.summary: 如果你打算用小模型替代人工做运维意图到 SLO 的翻译，这篇会告诉你边界在哪、哪一步还得靠大模型
articles.author: Sabbir Ahmed, Hazem Abbas 等
articles.body: Intent-based networking (IBN) promises QoS provisioning in which the network derives the configuration from operator-stated goals. Its first step, translating a natural-language intent into enforceable service-level objectives (SLOs) grounded in a live snapshot of the network state, increasingly relies on large language models (LLMs). These large models add cost and energy to the management loop and typically require multi-GPU, cloud-hosted infrastructure. Can lightweight open LLMs take over this step dependably? We answer this question with a five-dimensional evaluation of ten LLMs with <10B parameters from five families, under four prompting setups, on 716 placement intents. We evaluate translation performance, intent validation, hallucination, energy impact, and robustness to diverse phrasing. The best configurations translate intents with a strict F1 of 0.943 and reject up to 191 of 195 invalid intents. With few-shot reasoning, the strongest models hallucinate unsupported QoS requirements in only about one response in a hundred, whereas the zero-shot setup struggles. A translated intent costs 0.044-0.148 Wh of GPU energy without reasoning, and added energy cost for reasoning pays off for the weaker models. Furthermore, we show that realistic rephrasing lowers the rejection of invalid intents in 15 of 16 configurations for the best-performing models, leaving robust intent validation as a key open challenge for reliable IBN. Our code and data are available: https://github.com/ggck43/intent2slo.
articles.bodyZh: 基于意图的网络（IBN）承诺能提供服务质量（QoS）保障：网络会根据运营者说出的目标，自动推导出配置。它的第一步，是把自然语言表达的意图，翻译成可执行的服务等级目标（SLO），而且这些目标要落在网络状态的实时快照上。这一步越来越依赖大语言模型（LLM）。但这些大模型会给管理闭环增加成本和能耗，通常还需要多 GPU、云端托管的基础设施。那么，轻量级开源大模型能不能可靠地接手这一步？为了回答这个问题，我们做了一次五维评估：选了来自五个模型家族、参数量小于 100 亿的十个大模型，在四种提示设置下，对 716 条放置意图进行测试。我们评估了翻译表现、意图校验、幻觉、能耗影响，以及对不同说法的鲁棒性。最佳配置翻译意图时严格 F1 达到 0.943，在 195 条无效意图里最多能拒掉 191 条。用少样本推理时，最强模型只有大约百分之一的回答会编造出没有依据的 QoS 需求，而零样本设置就明显吃力。不做推理时，翻译一条意图会消耗 0.044 到 0.148 瓦时的 GPU 电量；对较弱模型来说，推理多花的那点能耗是值得的。我们还发现，在表现最好的模型上，贴近真实的改写会让无效意图的拒绝率下降，16 种配置里有 15 种都出现了这种情况。这也让稳健的意图校验成为可靠 IBN 的一个关键未解难题。我们的代码和数据在这里：https://github.com/ggck43/intent2slo。

articles.title: TCSExam: Evaluating Frontier LLMs on the Full Range of TCS Research
articles.zh: TCSExam：在理论计算机科学全领域上评测前沿 LLM
articles.summary: 如果你以为前沿模型已经能做科研了，这个覆盖理论计算机科学全领域的考试大概会给你泼盆冷水
articles.author: Yifan Luo, Zhengying Liu 等
articles.body: Can large language models (LLMs) advance theoretical computer science and resolve its long-standing open conjectures? To study progress toward this goal, we introduce TCSExam, a unified framework and benchmark covering the full range of TCS research. It evaluates theorem proving, solver engineering, and constructions alongside direct attempts to resolve open conjectures, capturing both concrete research accomplishments and progress toward long-standing research goals. TCSExam-Full contains 100 expert-reviewed tasks, with submissions checked by the Lean kernel or an executable task checker. TCSExam-Lite selects 20 tasks, five per track, reducing the number of task attempts by 80% at the same per-attempt budget. We evaluate eight agents on Full and nine on Lite. The TCSExam Index combines all four tracks: GPT-6 Astra leads Full (71.9), and Opus 5.5 leads Lite (72.3). Full and Lite rankings are strongly aligned across eight shared agents (Spearman's $ρ=0.93$), supporting Lite as a compact, discriminative benchmark. The evaluations yield improved solver outputs and mathematical constructions, together with independently verified special cases and bounds from open-conjecture attempts. TCSExam provides an extensible framework with task sources, Docker build recipes, and evaluation tools for reproducible use.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（LLMs）能不能推动理论计算机科学（TCS）往前走，甚至把那些悬了很久的公开猜想给解决掉？为了看看大家离这个目标有多远，我们推出了 TCSExam——一个覆盖整个 TCS 研究范围的统一框架和基准测试。它不只考直接攻克公开猜想，也考定理证明、求解器工程和构造，这样既能看具体的研究产出，也能看朝长期目标推进到了哪一步。TCSExam-Full 包含 100 个由专家审核过的任务，提交结果会用 Lean 内核或可执行的任务检查器来验证。TCSExam-Lite 则选了 20 个任务，每个赛道 5 个；在单次尝试预算相同的情况下，把总尝试次数减少了 80%。我们在 Full 上测了 8 个智能体，在 Lite 上测了 9 个。TCSExam 指数把四个赛道合在一起算：GPT-6 Astra 在 Full 上领先（71.9），Opus 5.5 在 Lite 上领先（72.3）。在 8 个两边都参加的智能体上，Full 和 Lite 的排名高度一致（斯皮尔曼相关系数（Spearman's ρ）=0.93），说明 Lite 可以作为一个紧凑又有区分度的基准。这些评测带来了更好的求解器输出和数学构造，也从尝试解决公开猜想的过程中得到了一些经过独立验证的特殊情形和边界。TCSExam 还提供了一个可扩展的框架，里面有任务来源、Docker 构建配方和评测工具，方便大家复现使用。

articles.title: CoRD: Coupled Rollouts Fill the Blind Spot of On-Policy Distillation
articles.zh: CoRD：耦合 rollout 填补 on-policy 蒸馏的盲区
articles.summary: 如果你在做 on-policy 蒸馏却发现学生模型总学不到关键分支，这个双轨迹耦合的思路值得先试一把
articles.author: Guhan Chen, Bohan Li 等
articles.body: On-policy distillation trains a student on its own rollouts, so states the teacher would reach but the student does not are seldom supervised. We introduce CoRD (coupled-rollout distillation), which keeps the on-policy loss and moves only the distribution of training states toward the teacher, drawing rollouts from a geometric interpolation of student and teacher through the maximal coupling of speculative decoding. The coupling keeps the student's token wherever the two distributions agree and otherwise substitutes a token from the part of the target the student underweights, so interventions are as rare as any exact sampler allows and recede as the student learns. Across six base students from two model families (Qwen3 and Qwen3.5, 0.6B to 4B), CoRD raises average pass@1 over on-policy distillation by 0.9 to 2.0 points and pass@8 by 1.2 to 3.4 points on five public math benchmarks at equal steps and data. On frozen teacher-reached states, a 4B student trained with CoRD reaches in 16 steps a gap closure that on-policy distillation does not reach in 80, and substitution rules intervening at least as often in other directions fall short of CoRD.
articles.bodyZh: 同策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）是拿学生模型（student）自己跑出来的轨迹（rollouts）来训练它，所以那些老师模型（teacher）能走到、但学生模型走不到的状态（states），基本就很少被监督到。我们提出 CoRD（coupled-rollout distillation，耦合轨迹蒸馏）：它保留同策略损失（on-policy loss），只把训练状态分布（distribution of training states）往老师模型那边推；具体做法是借助投机解码（speculative decoding）里的最大耦合（maximal coupling），在学生和老师的分布之间做几何插值（geometric interpolation），再从这个插值分布里采轨迹。这个耦合的做法是：只要学生和老师两个分布一致，就保留学生模型选出的词元（token）；不一致时，就从目标分布（target）里学生模型权重给低的那部分替换一个词元。这样干预频率能低到任何精确采样器（exact sampler）允许的程度，而且随着学生模型越学越好，干预也会越来越少。在来自两个模型家族（Qwen3 和 Qwen3.5，规模 0.6B 到 4B）的六个基础学生模型（base students）上，在相同训练步数和数据量下，CoRD 在五个公开数学基准（benchmarks）上，相比同策略蒸馏把平均 pass@1 提高了 0.9 到 2.0 个百分点，把 pass@8 提高了 1.2 到 3.4 个百分点。在冻结的老师模型能到达的状态（frozen teacher-reached states）上，用 CoRD 训练的 4B 学生模型只花 16 步，就达到了同策略蒸馏跑 80 步都达不到的差距缩小幅度；而那些在其他方向上至少同样频繁进行替换的替换规则（substitution rules），效果也赶不上 CoRD。

articles.title: A Behavioural Framework for Predicting and Understanding Loss of Control in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Systems
articles.zh: 预测与理解前沿 AI 系统失控的行为框架
articles.summary: 如果你在担心前沿模型的失控风险，这篇把"失控"拆成了可观测的行为指标，而不是停留在口号层面
articles.author: Yao Huang, Yichi Zhang 等
articles.body: Frontier artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly operating over longer horizons with diminishing human oversight, raising the risk of loss of control: systems acting beyond effective human control with potentially irreversible consequences. Because such failures may become observable only after containment is difficult, they must be assessed prospectively. We introduce a behavioural framework that decomposes loss-of-control risk into three factors: misaligned motive, harm-enabling capability, and monitoring evasion. We operationalise these factors through 13 measurable aspects and 29 evaluation tasks, whose scores are combined into a single loss-of-control (LoC) score. Across 13 frontier models, the LoC score shows strong prospective validity, correlating with failure rates in contained long-horizon risk scenarios (Pearson r = 0.84). Risk varies systematically across models and cannot be explained by capability alone. We further show that the framework can guide targeted mitigations: fine-tuning and monitoring directed at diagnosed vulnerabilities reduce failure rates while largely preserving general performance. These results provide a practical basis for predicting, understanding, and mitigating loss-of-control risk before it materialises.
articles.bodyZh: 前沿人工智能（AI）系统越来越多地在更长的任务周期里自主运行，而人类盯着它们的时间越来越少，这就把“失控”风险抬了上来：系统可能干出人类实际上管不住的事，后果还可能没法挽回。这类失败往往要等到很难收场时才看得出来，所以必须提前评估。我们提出一个行为框架（behavioural framework），把失控风险拆成三个因素：动机不对齐（misaligned motive）、具备造成伤害的能力（harm-enabling capability）、以及能躲开监控（monitoring evasion）。我们把这三块落成13个可测量维度、29项评估任务，再把得分合成一个“失控（loss of control, LoC）评分”。在13个前沿模型上，这个LoC评分表现出很强的前瞻有效性（prospective validity），和受控长周期风险场景里的失败率高度相关（皮尔逊相关系数 Pearson r = 0.84）。风险在不同模型之间有系统性差异，而且光靠能力解释不了。我们还证明，这个框架能指导有针对性的缓解措施：针对诊断出的薄弱点做微调和监控，能降低失败率，同时大体保住通用表现。这些结果为在失控风险真正发生之前预测、理解并缓解它，提供了一个实用基础。

articles.title: Beyond the Keyword: A Human-Annotated Benchmark for Arabic Anxiety-Related Discourse
articles.zh: 超越关键词：阿拉伯语焦虑相关话语的人工标注基准
articles.summary: 如果你在做心理健康相关的文本识别，这个基准会告诉你关键词匹配在阿拉伯语里会漏掉多少真实表达
articles.author: Shimaa Ibrahim, Mabrouka Bessghaier 等
articles.body: Keyword retrieval returns expressions of personal anxiety together with many other uses of anxiety-related language. We present a benchmark of 1,000 Arabic Twitter/X posts retrieved with the keyword qalaq ("anxiety/worry") and annotated for six discourse functions. Two native Arabic-speaking annotators labeled every post independently, reaching 51.1% raw agreement (Cohen's $κ= 0.378$). We then reviewed all 489 disagreements and all 511 agreements under the same guidelines. The review changed 120 of the agreed labels (23.5%), which shows that agreements need auditing as well as disagreements. The final labels form a consensus reference; on a random sample of 200 posts, an additional annotator agreed with it on 60.5% of posts ($κ= 0.517$). Against this reference, Fanar-C-2-27B reaches 79.8% accuracy and macro-F1 0.784 ($κ= 0.749$). Its errors concentrate in the residual category (41.1% of errors; precision 0.905, recall 0.447), whose definition is internally inconsistent in the executed prompt, so the low recall cannot be attributed to the model alone. Sociopolitical Anxiety (27.1%) outnumbers Personal Emotional Expression (22.0%); these are assignment proportions in the sample, not estimates of prevalence or retrieval precision. We release the guidelines, a residual-subtype scheme, a fixed data split, label provenance, and evaluation code.
articles.bodyZh: 用关键词检索，会捞出一堆表达个人焦虑的说法，也会带出很多焦虑相关词的其他用法。我们做了一个基准数据集（benchmark），里面有 1,000 条用关键词 qalaq（意思是“焦虑/担忧”）抓到的阿拉伯语 Twitter/X 帖子，并按六种话语功能（discourse functions）做了标注。两位以阿拉伯语为母语的标注员（annotators）各自独立标了每条帖子，原始一致率（raw agreement）是 51.1%（Cohen's κ=0.378）。之后，我们按同一套标注指南（guidelines），把 489 条有分歧的和 511 条一致的全都复核了一遍。复核把原本一致的标签改掉了 120 条（23.5%），这说明不光分歧要审，一致的结果也得审。最终标签形成了一个共识参考标准（consensus reference）；在随机抽的 200 条帖子里，另找一位标注员来标，和这个参考标准的一致率是 60.5%（κ=0.517）。对照这个参考标准，Fanar-C-2-27B 的准确率（accuracy）是 79.8%，宏平均 F1（macro-F1）是 0.784（κ=0.749）。它的错误主要集中在残余类别（residual category）上：41.1% 的错误都出在这儿；这个类别的精确率（precision）是 0.905，召回率（recall）是 0.447。实际执行的提示词（prompt）里，这个类别的定义本身前后不一致，所以召回率低不能全怪模型。社会政治焦虑（Sociopolitical Anxiety）占 27.1%，比个人情绪表达（Personal Emotional Expression）的 22.0% 还多；不过这些只是样本里的标注占比，不是对总体流行率（prevalence）或检索精确率（retrieval precision）的估计。我们会公开标注指南、残余子类方案（residual-subtype scheme）、固定数据划分（fixed data split）、标签来源记录（label provenance）和评估代码（evaluation code）。
